subject: youtube.execution.pilot_choice
summary: The recovered Council execution decision is to pilot only «داخل الصفقة» first; the other four concepts remain fully designed backlog and should not become serious new channel accounts until pilot data justifies expansion.

details.pilot_goal: prove accurate research -> narration -> visuals -> packaging -> sustainable cost across three videos
details.next_gate: if three videos pass quality and cost, allow limited publishing only after publishing capability is verified
